what: The client logo strip doesn’t flow, it rests and then slides. After the first 3s, it shifts right by one logo (width + gap) every 2s in .64s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.32,.95), so the next logo enters one at a time from the left edge. It is cloned enough times to fill the screen and loops endlessly.

options.first: Wait until first cell after sticking (s), default 3
options.dur: Length of one cell slide (s), default .64
options.dir: If left, moves to the left, default is right

from.where: index.js [data-logo-track] ”We work with” 22 logos — original ClientsCarousel (list reversed · cloned to screen width · 640ms cubic-bezier(.77,0,.32,.95) · every 2 seconds after the first 3). The site measures width in rem and starts after the opening ends
